concept: a taxidermied bear the museum forgot to lock up, stitched and sawdust-stuffed, that hates being looked at
a conscripted angel with its wings sewn shut, fighting for a warlord it despises
a courier's ghost who still runs the mountain road, and runs anyone who blocks it off the cliff
a glass-blower's furnace given a mouth, that swallows sand and breathes out shards
the drowned king's crown, a crab the size of a longboat that wears it and rules the wreck-fields
a mountain goat with antlers of living ice that butts climbers off the ledge and freezes the handholds behind them
a hanged judge whose noose still tightens around the guilty from a hundred feet away
a cliff-nesting hunter bird with a wingspan like a sail that carries off goats and, lately, children
